title: Cap. X Arg. VII: fulfillment of the promise not from uncertain free will but from the firmest decree and matching operation
pass_a_gloss: But what God promised unto the Son, the fulfilling of it is not to be fetched from the uncertain operation of human free will, but from the firmest decree of the divine will, and from an operation answering unto the same decree.
pass_b_english: What God promised the Son must be fetched not from the uncertain working of human free will, but from the firmest decree of the divine will and from an operation that answers to that decree.
source_text: Quod autem Deus promisit Filio, ejus impletio non ex incerta operatione humani arbitrii, sed ex firmissimo divinae voluntatis decreto, et operatione eidem decreto respondente arcessenda est.
notes: Densify De praedestinatione Cap. X Arg. VII cont. section 739. Pass A!=B. Packet praedestinatione_cap10_arg7_densify.
